# Innocent Nyalala, PhD - Faculty Monograph & Teaching Hub

> Personal academic website of Innocent Nyalala, Assistant Professor of Data Science and Artificial Intelligence at the School of Engineering and Science, Indian Institute of Technology Madras Zanzibar (IIT Madras Zanzibar), Associate Research Fellow at the Wadhwani School of Data Science and Artificial Intelligence (WSAI, IIT Madras), and Principal Investigator of SAAIL Lab. Formerly Part-Time Lecturer in the Department of Computer Science at Egerton University, Kenya, and researcher at Nanjing Agricultural University.

## Identity & Metrics
- **Name**: Innocent Nyalala, PhD (Dr. Innocent Nyalala)
- **Primary Appointment**: Assistant Professor of Data Science and AI, School of Engineering and Science, Indian Institute of Technology Madras Zanzibar, Bweleo, P.O. Box 2496, Zanzibar, Tanzania
- **Secondary Appointment**: Associate Research Fellow, Wadhwani School of Data Science and Artificial Intelligence (WSAI), IIT Madras, Chennai, India

## Signature Systems & Benchmarks
- **CropGuardNet**: Lightweight 481.6K-parameter CNN-Transformer running at 5.00 ms CPU ONNX inference across 35,420 crop images
- **DGS-Bench**: Balanced agricultural evaluation benchmark (Deep Learning Indaba 2026 Best Poster Award, Lagos)
- **CLOVES-4603 & ZSTC Compositional XAI**: Public Zanzibar commercial clove grading dataset (CVPR 2026 CV4A) and 99.45% F1 segmentation-first pipeline (ETRI Journal 2026)
- **CARA-FM**: Resource-aware agricultural foundation models (PMLR Vol. 302; Deep Learning Indaba 2025 Best Poster Award, Kigali)
- **Zanzibar Swahili Corpus & Dira**: Coastal Kiunguja prose and translationese provenance auditing (Swahili NLP)
- **PlacentaVision**: Calibrated three-view maternal imaging consortium with Penn State University and CPHK Pemba (9,883 images)
